title: Wolf meat

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Wolf meat is a basic food source obtained by killing Wolves.
When uncooked, it may be used to make the balanced dish Wolf jerky, or the health dish Wolf skewer. When placed on a Cooking station or Iron cooking station, it can be turned into Cooked wolf meat, or Coal if left to burn.

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text:
• Cooked wolf meat
• Coal, if left on a Cooking station for too long
• 2 Wolf jerky made using 1x Honey and 1x Wolf meat
• Wolf skewer made using 1x Wolf meat, 2x Mushroom and 1x Onion
Cooked wolf meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Wolf meat as ingredient.
